Title: Hey Scalpel! Pretty pictures, twisted morals, and fun places to go while you're in Chicago

Messages.Author: Art Martella
Messages.Body:
To whoever thinks they know:

1) Live from the Fetish Club Hunting Ground in beautiful Chicago,
Illinois, Gillian Krader gets Incriminating Videotape of Iliana. If
Iliana is later burned (she always did push herself a little too far),
and someone else later brings out another Iliana, does the Videotape
still work, or can Iliana point out that it's really just her evil twin,
Ilia?

2) Say later, Gillian takes her newfound Flamethrower and has a fight
with Matteus, Flesh Sculptor for throwing her out of the club. Matteus
takes the 2 aggravated damage like a man, but Gillian attempts to commit
Amaranth as he falls to torpor. Matteus then uses Reform Body to save
himself, but does Gillian get any of the diablerie bonuses or penalties
(i.e., Matteus' blood, equipment, a Blood Hunt)?

3) The Succubus Club (which has a Fetish Club in the basement,
naturally) lets you trade cards in play. If you trade minion cards, do
you put them on any minion in play? If so, does it have to be legal?
(i.e., if you trade an Art of Pain, does it have to go to an
Anti-Toreador?)

4) If you have a Concotion of Vitality (which are very popular in the
Succubus Club) can be burned at the beginning of an action, and prevent
the vampire from playing cards requiring disciplines until the action is
complete; but can the action itself require a discipline?

That's all for now. Until next time, keep your feet on the ground, keep
your head in the stars, and keep your kids out of the Succubus Club,
there's some funky stuff goin' on down there.

>2) Say later, Gillian takes her newfound Flamethrower and has a fight

>Amaranth as he falls to torpor. Matteus then uses Reform Body to save
>himself, but does Gillian get any of the diablerie bonuses or penalties
>(i.e., Matteus' blood, equipment, a Blood Hunt)?

I can answer this =)
reform body is an reaction or combat card. The diableri vote occurs after the
combat have ended, so you can't play reform body.
reform body is also an reaction card, but you can't "react" a diableri vote
since no action from any vampire have been made.

In Short: You can not play reform body when burned in an diableri vote...

>3) The Succubus Club (which has a Fetish Club in the basement,
>naturally) lets you trade cards in play. If you trade minion cards, do
>you put them on any minion in play? If so, does it have to be legal?
>(i.e., if you trade an Art of Pain, does it have to go to an
>Anti-Toreador?)

Why not?
Why not give that malkavian Antitribu your Sword Of Justice and see him
use adittional strikes to put people in deeeeeep sleeeep...
